outcome: Differential lipids (glycerolipids, glycerophospholipids, sphingomyelin, phosphatidylcholines, lysophosphatidylcholine)
cohort: The study included 70 offspring born to women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS-off) and 71 healthy control offspring.
finding: Offspring born to mothers with PCOS exhibited specific lipid profile alterations, including 44 significantly altered metabolites, indicating an increased risk of glucose metabolism and cardiovascular diseases.
